title: Hexkey catalog spec
description: A short description of one piece: archetype + product-page dimensions + options. scripts/generate.mjs expands it into public/pieces/<slug>/piece.json. Write every word yourself; use only public facts (names, dimensions, hardware types and counts).

size.description: Width × depth × height in cm, in the order product pages list them (beds: width × length × headboard height)

brand.description: Brand id from data/sources/brands.json (default ikea). Sets the label and the not-affiliated line.

instructionsUrl.description: Link to the brand's own official instructions (PDF or help page). We link it; we never copy or rehost it.

productUrl.description: The brand's own product page (ikea.com /p/ for IKEA; the brand site from brands.json otherwise). Never a PDF.
